item.title: Yamaguchi Events 2026: Lantern Festival, Kanmon Strait Fireworks & Summer Matsuri
item.description: Yamaguchi, the prefecture at the far western tip of Honshu, blends samurai history, dramatic coastlines and one of Japan’s most atmospheric festivals. Here you’ll find the arch-stone Kintaikyo Bridge, the cliff-top red torii of Motonosumi Inari, the vast Akiyoshido cave, the old castle town of Hagi — and, each August, a 600-year-old festival that fills the streets of Yamaguchi City with tens of thousands of glowing red lanterns. Its 2026 event calendar peaks in summer, with a famous lantern night and one of Japan’s biggest fireworks displays over the Kanmon Strait.
